definition: causing trouble because hard to handle
description: A young man in a rust t-shirt and jeans presses his back against a pink wall on a steep, narrow stone stairway and holds up one end of a big mustard velvet sofa, tilted diagonally between the walls. Below, a young woman in a lilac t-shirt and shorts pushes the lower end, laughing and looking up at him. The sofa shifts a little as they strain. A fallen cushion lies on a step. Colourful houses, a whale mural, green railings, red geraniums and a harbour with ships far below surround them.
